summary: The 'MaintHelp' file is related to the maintenance of help documentation in a web application. It involves the management and display of help records, including adding, editing, deleting, and viewing help entries. The content handles various user interactions with help entries through a grid view and a detailed view component.
purpose: The purpose of 'MaintHelp' is to facilitate the management of help documentation within a web application, allowing users to add, edit, delete, and view help content effectively.

fields.name: HelpTitleAlt
fields.description: An alternate title for help documentation

fields.name: HelpText
fields.description: Main text content for help documentation

fields.name: ScreenName
fields.description: Identifier for the screen the help documentation is associated with

actors.name: User
actors.description: Interacts with the help system to manage help entries

workflows.name: Manage Help Entries
steps: User loads the help maintenance page
User views existing help entries in a grid
User selects an entry to edit or delete
User can add new help entries
System processes updates and communicates results

business_rules: Screen Title and Text must be specified for all help entries.
Only users with valid session can access the help maintenance page.
system_behavior: Displays help entries in a grid format.
Allows in-place editing of help entries through a detailed view.
Deletes help entries upon user confirmation.
Refreshes data upon interactions to maintain up-to-date entries.
exceptions: If a required field is not filled, the entry will not be saved.
